name: Reco Love Blue Ocean
source:
The nameable protagonist of Reco Love is a second-year high school student who attends Mitsumi Academy, a school that consists of every grade from elementary to high school. While attending the “Mitsumi Camp” study and exercise training camp for the two months of summer vacation, he will deepen his bonds with the heroines, and aim for success in confessing his love for the girl he showcases on film at the Mitsumi Festival on the final day of camp.

In this version, the protagonist joins the Cute Movie Club, of which student council president Nagisa Misaki is president. While receiving advice from his younger sister, Mana, the protagonist, a story as fresh as a blue summer ocean will develop featuring his classmate, drama club member, and main heroine Miu Sagara, and other characters.

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2016/04/reco-love-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
《Reco Love》的可命名主人公是一名高中二年级学生，就读于光海学园，这是一所涵盖小学至高中的学校。在为期两个月的暑假里，他参加学习与锻炼并重的“光海集训”，与女主角们加深羁绊，并努力在集训最后一天的光海祭上，向自己在影片中展示的女孩告白成功。

本作中，主人公加入了由学生会长美咲渚担任会长的可爱电影社。在妹妹真奈的建议下，主人公与同班同学、戏剧社成员兼女主角相良美羽，以及其他角色之间，将展开一段如蔚蓝夏日海洋般清新的故事。

[来源：[url=http://gematsu.com/2016/04/reco-love-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu[/url]]
